title: Enterprise Account Manager
description:
**Overview**
**About Certara**
Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
  
  
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
  
  
As an Enterprise Account Manager you will be working with world class expert drug development consultants in client engagements and be supported during the Business Development process by required expert teams. As a precursor to consultant engagement with the client, our candidates will be responsible for identifying and pursuing strategic business with clients after qualifying them with a needs assessment including, understanding their business model and corporate objectives, understanding their development program focus, objectives and priorities, understanding their critical decisions and challenges and financial position. It is after this qualification process that the appropriate Certara consulting resources are identified for engagement and are introduced to the client as the Certara resource team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Identify and pursue strategic business with new clients
* Identify and pursue business growth opportunities within assigned clients
* Conduct proper discovery to understand and qualify client needs, including understanding of business model and corporate objectives, development program focus, and priorities
* Negotiate contract terms by understanding critical decision timelines, challenges, and financial position
* Lead and facilitate client meetings with consulting resources, ensure internal stakeholders are properly briefed on client meeting plan and management
* Act as main liaison for client and Certara
* Facilitate execution of CDA/ MSA
* Collaborate with project team to ensure timely delivery and quality of all project deliverables
* Communicate issues, issue status, and issue resolution on a regular basis
* Provide leadership and timely feedback to keep all stakeholders, including senior management, informed of project progress
* Ensure Salesforce is properly updated

**Qualifications**

* Minimum a Bachelor’s Degree (science related curriculum a plus) with a demonstrated career path in Business Development to support the sought drug development experience and understanding required for this position.
* A seasoned and well-rounded biopharmaceutical executive is required with minimum combined business development experience of 3+ years
* Thorough understanding of the drug development processes, with the ability to converse with C-suite leadership in Biopharma companies, is essential. Thorough understanding of Clinical Pharmacology and Model Informed Drug Development (PK/PD, QSP, PBPK and MBMA) is a plus.
* Possesses broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical space and current macro trends within the industry. Able to lead strategic business planning process based on a thorough understanding of industry trends and opportunities and effectively solve strategic challenges.
* Proven ability to lead initiatives: work collaboratively with teams to achieve objectives. Achieves organizational focus on key priorities. Provides clear direction, delegates, actively communicates. Superior project management skills.
* Proven success in working collaboratively with cross functional commercialization teams with a strong business orientation and ability to view issues from multiple functional perspectives.
* Experienced and adept in a variety of negotiating settings. Able to engage effectively; establishes a clear negotiation strategy and manages a tight process.
* Proven experience in identifying, evaluating and pursuing business development opportunities within new and existing key markets.
* Demonstrated ability to gain credibility through successful leadership in a matrix environment, across a range of functions, position levels and geography
* Strong communication and influencing skills

*Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Vice President, Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions
description: About Citco JOB DESCRIPTION Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.comAbout The Team & Business LineFund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.Strategic Operations is a dedicated function within Private Assets. It brings transformation delivery, project execution, business analysis, operational initiatives and implementation support into one team, reducing the delivery burden on BAU Operations and maintaining ownership from design through adoption.The group will be split across three distinct focus areas, aligned under two individual leaders:Operating Model, Product & Client Solutions: led by the Operating Model & Product leader, this area will define how services should run end to end, shape scalable products and solutions, support complex client implementations, and ensure client commitments are operationally deliverable.Data, Reporting & Platform Enablement: led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will define Operations requirements for data, reporting and platforms, strengthen data quality and lineage, and carry solutions through testing, deployment and adoption.Digital Workflow, Automation & AI: also led by the Technology, Data & Delivery leader, this area will identify and deliver workflow, automation and AI opportunities, establish appropriate controls, and measure whether the expected benefits are realised.The group works in close partnership with Operations, the Transformation Office, IT, Tactical Operations and Marquee Client teams. Roles may be permanent or approximately 12-month rotational assignments anchored in strategic locations. Rotational colleagues will join from the business, help shape and deliver change, and return to the line with broader project experience.ResponsibilitiesYour RoleYou will deliver operating model and product change from the problem, through testing, to deployment and adoption. Document current state end to end, identify root causes, and design the target state process. Build the case for change — quantifying effort, risk and benefit in terms the business recognises. Write and agree business requirements with IT, the Transformation Office and the relevant focus areas, and support them through build and delivery. Design, plan and execute testing, including UAT, and manage defect resolution through to sign-off. Contribute operational input to client pitches, POCs and presentations, and translate client requirements into an operational design that can be built and run. Support implementation of fund structures, new client setups, complex client transitions and onboarding on our accounting platforms, alongside Client Integration. Work directly with Operations teams to make sure change is understood, trained out and genuinely adopted. Assess where a redesign or client solution delivered once can be applied more widely, and document the case. Produce project documentation, status reporting and ad hoc analysis as required. QualificationsAbout YouYou have 8+ years’ experience in private assets accounting or operations, at a fund administrator, fund manager or comparable environment. Hands-on experience of process improvement, system implementation or project delivery. Strong technical knowledge of private assets processes — general ledger, capital activity, fee and waterfall calculations, financial statements and investor reporting. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interrogate data and evidence a recommendation. Confident in front of a client, and comfortable explaining operational constraints clearly. Project management skills with attention to detail and a proven ability to multi-task. Confident engaging both operational teams and technology partners. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel); familiarity with reporting, workflow or automation tooling an advantage. Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics; professional accounting designation is preferred. What We Expect Of The Strategic Operations TeamRegardless of role or focus area, everyone in Strategic Operations is expected to demonstrate the following: Deep technical and operational knowledge — genuine depth in how our processes, data and platforms actually work — the detail that only comes from having run the work. Curiosity — the instinct to ask why a process looks the way it does, to challenge the answer, and to keep asking whether there is a better way. A transformational mindset — comfortable redesigning end to end rather than patching, and prepared to see change through past go-live to the point where it is genuinely adopted. Ownership through to adoption — accountability does not end at delivery; success is measured by whether the change sticks in the business. Commercial and client awareness — an understanding of what we can genuinely run, so that what we commit to a client is deliverable. Global mindset — working across regions, jurisdictions and time zones, and designing solutions that scale beyond a single desk, client or location. Ambition to shape Citco’s future — an appetite to help build the operating model we will run for years, and to be measured on whether it works. Our BenefitsYour well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Financial Inclusion District Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vedavaag Systems Ltd is a technology\-driven company headquartered in India, focusing on innovative solutions that support governance, financial services, and inclusive growth. The organization works closely with public and private sector partners to extend essential services to underserved and rural communities. Vedavaag Systems Ltd emphasizes operational efficiency, customer\-centric service delivery, and sustainable models that promote financial inclusion. The company offers opportunities for professionals interested in social impact, technology\-enabled service delivery, and expanding access to financial services across diverse regions in India.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Financial Inclusion District Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Telangana, India. This role oversees district\-level financial inclusion initiatives, including planning, implementing, and monitoring programs that extend banking and financial services to underserved communities. The person in this role will manage field teams, coordinate with partner banks and agencies, track performance against outreach and service targets, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and guidelines. Daily responsibilities include reviewing operational reports, resolving escalated issues, conducting site visits, facilitating community engagement activities, and ensuring quality customer service and data accuracy. The District Manager will also promote inclusive practices, support training and capacity building for staff, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and service delivery.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong Program Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and monitor district\-level financial inclusion initiatives.
* Experience in Diversity \& Inclusion and Employee Engagement to foster an inclusive, motivated, and high\-performing field workforce.
* Excellent Communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and community stakeholders.
* Background in banking, financial services, or financial inclusion programs is highly beneficial.
* Ability to analyze data, prepare performance reports, and use insights to drive improvements in outreach and service quality.
* Proven people\-management experience, including supervising field teams and conducting training and performance evaluations.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, social sciences, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site across district locations in Telangana and willingness to travel within the assigned region as needed.
